wars.name: Third Italian War of Independence
wars.outcome: Armistice of Cormons 12 August; Treaty of Vienna 3 October 1866; Venetia ceded through Napoleon III on 19 October and annexed after the plebiscite of 21-22 October.

wars.name: Italo-Turkish War
wars.outcome: War declared on the Ottoman Empire in October 1911; Italy gained Libya; the Dodecanese were Italian-administered, formalised by the 1923 Treaty of Lausanne.

wars.name: Italian front of the First World War
wars.outcome: The 1915 London Pact promised Italy the lands it annexed in 1919: Trieste and Trentino-Alto Adige; Zara and the Dalmatian islands came with Rapallo in 1920.

wars.name: Albanian rebellion against the Italian protectorate
wars.outcome: An Albanian rebellion 'led the Italians to agree to return the occupied bay of Vlore to Albania' in 1920.

wars.name: Italian invasion of Albania
wars.outcome: 'In 1939, Italy invaded and captured Albania', which became a separate kingdom in personal union with the Italian crown.

wars.name: Invasion of Yugoslavia and Italian annexations
wars.outcome: Invasion on 6 April 1941; Italian forces entered Ljubljana on 12 April; Yugoslavia surrendered on 17 April; Italy annexed the Ljubljana Province, large sections of Dalmatia, Kosovo and the Bay of Kotor and ruled Montenegro as a governorate.

wars.name: Italian occupation of Greece
wars.outcome: 'Hellenic State (Greece) (1941-1943)': the Italians controlled portions of occupied Greece until the armistice of 8 September 1943.

wars.name: Italian occupation of Corsica and south-eastern France
wars.outcome: 'Italian-occupied France was expanded with the occupation of Corsica' in November 1942; the occupation ends with the armistice of September 1943.

wars.name: German occupation of northern and central Italy
wars.outcome: After the September 1943 surrender 'German forces established the Italian Social Republic' in the occupied north and centre; the kingdom's army, the 'Italian Co-belligerent Army', fought on the other side.

certainty.note: State frontiers with the Papal States (to 1870), Austria (Treaty of Vienna, 3 October 1866) and France; the Eritrean and Tientsin holdings are small and approximate.

The 1920 Treaty of Rapallo fixes the eastern frontier by article and a boundary commission; the occupation zones in Albania (1917-1920, 1939-1943), Montenegro, Greece and France, and the concessions, are approximate.
The front between the kingdom and the German-held Social Republic is not on the pages.
